comments.value: As shown in the image, Navigation Static and OffMeshLinkGeneration have become unselectable.
There is also the fact that you can't access the AI tab anymore or the old NavMesh components.
@{62defd9d1c77eb5da69fe068|full_name}: That's because you need to install the package for it via the Package Manager.
It would be great to be able to build NavMesh at runtime with this update!
We're working on this! This was trickier than expected due to some changes in the new package, but it's nothing we can't handle 😎
I'm looking forward to implementing it! Go for it!

We finished the development of this feature!

It should be available in one of our upcoming major releases.

There are some caveats - for example, you won't be able to create runtime agents. We'll write more about those caveats in the release notes.
@{63691297469f06772579fe6f|full_name} Cuando sale la versión??? Mis cucarachas ya quieren estar vivas & moverse de manera aleatoria por el mapa.

Hi @{6662b7f75ebeed47f4c385a4|full_name}! I'm glad you're excited!

We still need to write documentation for the new navmesh system before we release it. We *may* also want to create an SDK example, but that's less important.
Not yet! Most of the team is back from their summer vacation, so we'll get back to finishing this.

details: With the recent SDK update to Unity 2022, the Navigation feature that was previously built into Unity has been deprecated and is now introduced through an official package. Settings like Navigation Static and OffMeshLinkGeneration have become non-selectable by default due to the change from Static settings. This has made setting up NavMesh in the Unity 2022 environment more challenging. I would like VRChat to support the new method of Navigation setup, which is the NavMeshSurface.
title: Support the New AI Navigation in Unity 2022.
